title: Minimax Estimation of Quantile Dose-Response under Rough Confounding
banked_reason: Fixed-dose causal identification is false under the proposed assumptions; the claimed uniform logarithm-free upper bound was retracted after a scoped repair.
gap_reasons: The claimed causal identification is false under the stated full-data assumptions: because T is continuous, consistency constrains Y(t) only at almost-everywhere treatment values, so Y(t0) can be changed without altering the observed law while preserving pointwise weak unconfoundedness.

The logarithm-free upper bound also rests on the sweeping product-process assertion (18), whose brief pairing argument does not establish the stated supremum bound for random pilot-threshold coefficients, mixed resolutions, and reused folds.
Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived an observed-functional lower experiment and attempted an observable multiscale upper bound at the matching rate. A scoped repair of the fixed-dose causal identification and uniform product-process claims failed: a diagonal counterexample invalidates the causal bridge, and the solver retracted the logarithm-free upper result. A future topic needs a newly specified causal model or an observed-functional target and a new proof of the uniform bound; this banked note does not establish either headline.
tldr: At a fixed continuous dose, the causal quarter-quantile is identified from the observed law. The observational minimax MSE and uniformly honest expected-length frontiers are now matched at \(n^{-8/15}\) and \(n^{-4/15}\): a normalized same-class fuzzy experiment gives the lower bounds, and a fully observable tapered multiscale Taylor cutout attains them without an oracle Gram matrix or a logarithmic loss. The treatment-density oracle remains strictly faster, with MSE \(n^{-4/5}\) and honest length \(n^{-2/5}\).
gap: Published QDRF methods provide structured-GPS inference, balancing-weight bands, or high-level higher-order upper bounds, but no same-class minimax MSE and honest expected-length frontier for rough confounding.
fill: A normalized sign-mixture converse and an observable dyadic multiscale correction jointly target a constant-factor frontier while preserving density positivity, normalization, and feasible weighting.
